updates.title: First attribute implemented for the Pskem pilot
updates.summary: Mean elevation calculated for 20 native basin units. The cached run took 7.697 seconds; 15 of 20 comparisons are within the predeclared 1 m tolerance. Five mismatches remain under review.

updates.title: All 281 original attributes captured for Pskem; 34 candidates computed
updates.summary: 20 Pskem units; 5,620 reference records, including 9 original missing values. All 30 WorldClim temperature/precipitation attributes pass numerical comparison for every basin; 4 elevation attributes need further method review. 247 attributes await source-method preparation. Full processing 177.076 seconds; independent reproduction remains pending.

updates.title: Two-atlas regional programme and basin substitute tab
updates.summary: Six stages cover reference joins, pilot-to-region HydroATLAS and environmental-atlas methods, research publication, temporal/resolution storage and monitoring/ontology. Temporal storage starts before new dated ingestion. Basin modal shows only exact-ID published substitutes in light green. Regional runtime remains a projection requiring a batch benchmark.

updates.title: Observation/revision contract adopted; pilot evidence staged
updates.summary: ATLAS_MODULES/core/observations.py makes the REPRODUCIBILITY.md long table executable: identity, revisions and provenance are enforced on every record. The frozen Pskem run is staged as 10,260 rows (5,620 reference imports, 3,960 open-data estimates, 680 candidates) with 49 nulls that keep their reasons. Zero dated observations: static values, source epochs and climatologies are recorded as such, and no observation year is invented. A January climatology built from 2003-2023 MODIS imagery keeps that window and stays one climatology; land-cover class 01 is never a month. 83 attributes whose family has no pinned source release in this run are excluded rather than written as sourceless nulls.
